company_about: We're a digital healthcare company building the platform that powers our clinical and pharmacy operations.
description: About the role We're a digital healthcare company building the platform that powers our clinical and pharmacy operations. We're expanding that platform significantly this year, and we're looking for a senior backend engineer to help design and build its next generation. You'll take ownership of backend services from initial architecture through deployment and long-term maintenance. You'll design scalable systems, implement new features, review code, improve application performance, and continuously reduce technical debt. You'll regularly switch between multiple products and projects, helping teams deliver features quickly without compromising quality or maintainability. Beyond writing code, you'll participate in architecture discussions, mentor developers, review pull requests, and help shape the engineering standards followed across the company. As AI continues to play an increasingly important role in our products, you'll also help build intelligent workflows, integrate AI services, and explore new ways of using modern language models to improve customer experiences and internal operations. What you'll be doing Designing and building backend services in Laravel, from architecture through to production Working on core platform capabilities: data modelling, APIs, background processing, and integrations Designing secure, well-documented, versioned REST APIs Building event-driven and asynchronous systems with queues and background jobs Optimising database performance and application scalability Writing automated tests and helping improve our engineering and release practices Integrating third-party services, including commerce, logistics, and AI/LLM APIs Reviewing code and helping raise the overall standard of the team What we're looking for 7+ years of professional backend development, with at least 3 years of strong Laravel experience in production systems you helped design we care more about what you've built than the exact number of years Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming ( OOP ), SOLID principles, design patterns, and system design Strong data modelling and system design instincts, and the ability to reason about trade-offs Experience with Shopify APIs, Eloquent ORM optimisation, MySQL performance tuning, Redis, queue-based systems, AWS infrastructure, and scalable REST APIs is essential Solid MySQL depth (indexing, query optimisation, performance under growth), plus Redis and queue-based asynchronous processing Experience with AWS, Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD, application monitoring, and performance optimization is essential Testing as a habit, you write tests, you expect CI to catch problems, and you take reliability seriously Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch), enough to be self-sufficient Clear written communication and the ability to document and defend design decisions Nice to have Experience in a regulated domain (healthcare, fintech, or similar) where compliance and auditability are design inputs

title: Assistant Clinical Coder-Coding
functional_area: Doctor / Nurse / Paramedics / Hospital Technicians / Medical Research
description: Responsible for abstracting and analyzing clinical information from medical records and relevant documents, translating the information into diagnostic and operative procedure codes in accordance with the clinical coding system. Assigns codes for diagnoses, treatments, and procedures according to the appropriate classification system outpatient (OP)/emergency department (ED) or observation short stay. Oversees and reviews provider documentation to determine principal diagnosis, comorbidities and complications, secondary conditions and surgical procedures. Adheres to official coding guidelines when coding with accuracy and completeness as supported by documentation. Ensures accurate coding by clarifying diagnosis and procedural information through a query process. Assigns Present on Admission (POA) value for inpatient diagnoses. Ensures accurate physician name against each service and accurate time and date. Interacts with physicians and other areas when additional coding information is needed; for example to prevent medical necessity denials. Prepares and reviews documentation to verify and when necessary, correct the patient disposition upon discharge. Maintains the assigned target of production and accuracy of Coding. Prioritizes work to ensure the timeframe of medical record coding meets regulatory requirements. Engages with the physicians in the Coding Query process and provides training as necessary. Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and adheres to official coding guidelines. Accountabilities Ensures that codes are assigned correctly and sequenced appropriately as per government and insurance regulation
